THE 3-POINT KING 🎮🏀 December 14, 2021. Madison Square Garden. Steph needs two threes to pass Ray Allen.

• He ties it early in the 1st quarter
• Then SPLASH: No. 2,974
• In 789 games. Ray Allen needed 1,300
• Warriors win 105-96, with Allen and Reggie Miller in the building

Will anyone ever catch Steph? 👇
